text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm preparing for training one day, when
a lone
Umamusume comes charging onto
the track with
all the enthusiasm in the
world.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right! Here I go! I'm gonna finish first
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Of course I am! Today's a scrimmage! You don't even know how much I've been looking forward to this!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run my heart out, make a
name for
myself, and become a Triple
Crown champion like
President Rudolf
one day!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Exhale... I-I'm fine. My body and my spirit just aren't always on the same page...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If I push myself too hard and collapse, I
won't be
able to take part in the
scrimmage... But I want to
make sure I'm
fully ready for it.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Great idea! Stretches aren't too
physically taxing,
and they're a great
way to prevent injuries!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll start with a good ol' forward
bend! Hup!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Th-that crack... I think I put a little too
much
oomph into it...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm... fine... I'll take things a bit more
slowly...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thankfully, it doesn't seem like she hurt
herself. I
watch over Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
like a hawk as she
does her stretches
with a little more care than
before.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, warming up with a light jog sounds
good!
That won't be too hard on my
body either!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the suggestion! I'll get
started right
away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Or so she says, before taking off in a
flat-out
sprint that doesn't remotely
resemble a leisurely
jog.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, oops! That's right! I let my
enthusiasm get the
better of me.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Let me try that again! Nice and slow!
Keep it light!
